template.title: GPU E2E triage
template.summary: Loop policy tuned for hunting flaky GPU/infra failures: long wall-clock, deeper diagnostics, more validation passes.

note: GPU-triage template — generous diagnostic rounds for cross-system failure investigations.

config.yaml:
# dev-loop configuration for this repository.
#
# Template: gpu-triage-starter
# Workflow: investigate flaky GPU/infra failures across logs + metrics +
# Jenkins. Trade speed for thoroughness; the playbooks shipped with the
# harness do the heavy lifting.

runs_dir: .dev-loop/runs
default_provider: replay
scenarios_dir: scenarios

policy:
  max_code_iterations: 8
  max_validation_attempts_per_iteration: 3
  max_diagnostic_rounds_per_failure: 5
  max_total_wall_clock_minutes: 180

notes: gpu-triage-starter template — bring your own Jenkins/Grafana fixtures.
